name: Aki
source:
The older cat sister of the "twin gods". The one who possesed Ayano and the main cause of her growing cat ears.
Cheerful, bright, and curious. She tends to act without thinking of the consequences, which often makes Tsuki angry.
However, she always wants the best for the school and its students. The twins have been protecting Kuji Academy for many years.
